text: この　どうくつに　すごい　カセキが　あるって　きいて　きたの

structure.jp: この　どうくつに　すごい　カセキが　あるって
structure.en: that there's an amazing fossil in this cave

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and wraps up what was said or heard. あるって　きいて = 'having heard that there is one'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions in order, the first being the reason for the second. きいて　きた = 'I heard, so I came'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives an explanation in a soft, feminine way. きたの = 'that's why I came'.
